indicators.name: Air transport, passengers carried
indicators.definition: Passengers carried by air carriers registered in the reporting country, including domestic and international traffic.

indicators.name: Air transport, registered carrier departures worldwide
indicators.definition: Domestic takeoffs and takeoffs abroad by air carriers registered in the reporting country.

indicators.name: International tourism, number of arrivals
indicators.definition: Inbound international tourist arrivals; this is trips/arrivals, not unique people.

indicators.name: International tourism, number of departures
indicators.definition: Outbound international tourist departures; this is trips/departures, not unique people.

caveat: Country-level annual aggregates only. Air passengers are attributed to the country where the carrier is registered, not necessarily the country where passengers boarded. Tourism arrivals/departures count trips, not unique individuals, and collection methods vary by country. Missing values are not zero. Not airport-specific, airline-specific, monthly or individual passenger data.
